messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback triggered for embeddings v4.0.1 - p95 errors 3.6% > auto threshold 3%
emily: Noted. Holding auto-rollback 10m to triage. I'll override interlock briefly.
raj: Good call. Can we route a small safety slice to v4.0.0 while we inspect?
tasha: I'll grep logs and pull 50 samples. command for routing split?
ops-bot: Routing: use `redwood route update --service=emb --split=85:15 --versions=4.0.1,4.0.0`
emily: Applying 85/15 now. Posting a heads-up to #customer-success draft.
raj: Samples show repeated "quant_decode_mismatch" on gpu0. Suspect quant build.
tasha: If we hit >5% within 10m we should do immediate manual rollback to avoid SLA impact.
ops-bot: Trend: 3.1% -> 3.4% -> 3.6% -> 5.2% (now). Threshold breached.
emily: Executing manual rollback runbook. Pinning v4.0.0 and routing 100%. `redwood release pin --service=emb --version=4.0.0 --note="manual rollback: quant regression"`
deploy-bot: Routing update complete: embeddings -> 100% v4.0.0
ops-bot: Post-cutover metrics: p95 0.9% at 5m, error-rate back to baseline.
raj: Collecting traces for incident. I'll open INC-2026-7890 and attach artifacts.
emily: Posting customer blurb: "Rolled back embeddings to v4.0.0 due to a regression in v4.0.1 affecting a subset of requests. No data loss; technical follow-up incoming."
tasha: Recommend adding a quant-kernel preflight to release checklist. I'll file the ticket.
emily: Closing thread after incident ticket + release note update. Thanks all.
